messages:
rachel: Strange onboarding blocker: locally-linked SDK in our monorepo (pnpm workspace) behaves differently on simulator vs web. On RN simulator auth middleware isn't applied and requests go unauthenticated. Full reinstall doesn't help, only clearing Metro cache.

sam: that sounds like duplicate module copies. Metro + pnpm symlinks can resolve the package twice (one under node_modules of app, one under workspace node_modules). You get two separate module singletons so the SDK's global init (fetch interceptor + polyfills) runs in one instance but the app imports the other.

mike: yep. I hit this before: `npm ls @our/sdk` shows two versions/paths. Metro dedupe rules differ from Node's resolver. Also worth checking `resolver.nodeModulesPath` in metro.config.

oliver: quick repro? If you `require.resolve('@our/sdk')` from app JS and from a metro-evaluated module they might point to different fs locations. Workarounds: 1) publish a react-native export and use `import '@our/sdk/react-native'` to force a single entry; 2) add a tiny top-level file that sets up globals and re-exports the SDK so both sides use same module id; 3) configure Metro to watch the workspace package and provide extraNodeModules mapping so it's resolved consistently.

rachel: typings also broken in the editor: TS server resolves the package to the monorepo source while Metro picks the built cjs bundle which has `export =` types. That caused `import Redwood from '@our/sdk'` to fail in app TS.

sam: fix by shipping ESM types with `export default` and conditional exports in package.json: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js", "react-native": "./dist/rn/index.js" } } and `types` pointing to the ESM d.ts. Also advise consumers to set TS pathMappings to prefer the root package during local dev.

mike: another small workaround for pnpm: in app package.json add a `resolutions`/`pnpm.overrides` so there's a single hoisted copy of the SDK, or add a Metro `extraNodeModules` alias to force one path. Both reduce the dup singletons.

rachel: thanks — we'll try: add react-native export + tiny rn entry that imports polyfills and auth sync, update types to ESM default, and tweak metro config to map the workspace package. Will report back.

devex-bot: Note: created ticket #1150 for monorepo-local-sdk onboarding flake. CI: sample-expo-local-linking flaky.
